why.en: Opened this round of the race with the OpenAI investment, and has since built the most hedged position in the industry: an OpenAI stake, an Anthropic stake, a Mistral deal, and an in-house MAI model family running on custom silicon.
why.zh: 以对 OpenAI 的投资开启了这一轮竞赛，此后建立了业内最对冲的持仓结构：OpenAI 股权、Anthropic 股权、Mistral 协议，以及跑在自研芯片上的 MAI 自研模型家族。

title.en: Companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
title.zh: 把一切押在单一 AI 上的公司可能活不下来

title.en: Looking Ahead to 2026

note.en: 'We have moved past the initial phase of discovery and are entering a phase of widespread diffusion.' Argues the win in 2026 is not the biggest model in a datacenter but how AI shows up in daily life — and calls for moving from the 'brain' phase to the 'nervous system' phase.
note.zh: 「我们已经越过最初的发现阶段，正在进入广泛扩散阶段。」主张 2026 年的胜负不在于数据中心里最大的模型，而在于 AI 如何进入日常生活 —— 并呼吁从「大脑」阶段走向「神经系统」阶段。

title.en: In my annual letter, I share how we’re building a frontier ecosystem to turn technological progress into real-world outcomes and economic opportunity for people
title.zh: In my annual letter, I share how we’re building a frontier ecosystem to turn technological progress into real-world outcomes and economic opportunity for people

note.en: Nadella's annual letter outlines how Microsoft is building a 'frontier ecosystem' to turn AI progress into real-world economic opportunity.
note.zh: 纳德拉在年度信函中阐述了微软如何打造“前沿生态系统”，将AI技术进步转化为现实世界的经济机遇。

title.en: Today in Paris, we announced new capabilities across Microsoft Sovereign Cloud, expanding choice and control for organizations running their most sensitive work
title.zh: Today in Paris, we announced new capabilities across Microsoft Sovereign Cloud, expanding choice and control for organizations running their most sensitive work

note.en: Nadella announced new Microsoft Sovereign Cloud capabilities in Paris, expanding choice and control for organizations running sensitive workloads.
note.zh: Nadella在巴黎宣布微软主权云（Sovereign Cloud）新增功能，为运行敏感工作负载的组织提供更多选择和控制权。

title.en: Great to meet with the @saintgobain team in Paris today and learn how they’re using Microsoft Discovery to help accelerate the development of new more-efficient
title.zh: Great to meet with the @saintgobain team in Paris today and learn how they’re using Microsoft Discovery to help accelerate the development of new more-efficient

note.en: Nadella described meeting with Saint-Gobain in Paris to discuss how the company uses Microsoft Discovery, Microsoft's AI platform for scientific research, to speed development of more efficient construction materials.
note.zh: 纳德拉介绍了他在巴黎与圣戈班团队的会面，讨论该公司如何利用微软的AI科研平台Microsoft Discovery加速更高效建筑材料的研发。

title.en: I recently wrote about why we need to treat models as insider risks, with security controls sitting outside the model itself. Today, we're putting that principl
title.zh: I recently wrote about why we need to treat models as insider risks, with security controls sitting outside the model itself. Today, we're putting that principl

note.en: Nadella said Microsoft is expanding a program that treats AI models as insider risks, putting security controls outside the model itself rather than relying on the model to police itself.
note.zh: 纳德拉表示，微软正在扩展一项将AI模型视为"内部风险"的安全项目，将安全控制设置在模型外部，而非依赖模型自我约束。

title.en: In @Nature this week, our new research shows how machine learning can improve weather forecasts two to six weeks out, a timeframe that's historically been very
title.zh: In @Nature this week, our new research shows how machine learning can improve weather forecasts two to six weeks out, a timeframe that's historically been very

note.en: Nadella highlighted new Nature research showing machine learning can extend weather-forecast skill to two-to-six-week timeframes, previously very hard to predict.
note.zh: Nadella介绍了《自然》杂志发表的新研究，显示机器学习可以将天气预报的有效范围延长到两到六周，这在以往很难预测。

title.en: Today we are announcing our biggest bet yet on our own silicon. Starting next calendar year, we will scale our Maia family to multi-gigawatt deployments, making
title.zh: Today we are announcing our biggest bet yet on our own silicon. Starting next calendar year, we will scale our Maia family to multi-gigawatt deployments, making

note.en: Nadella announced Microsoft's largest-ever bet on its own silicon, scaling the Maia chip family to multi-gigawatt deployments as the primary inference system for its services.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布微软史上最大规模的自研芯片投入，将把Maia芯片系列扩展到吉瓦级部署，作为其服务的主要推理系统。

title.en: Introducing Microsoft-Decision-1, our new model for fast decision-making. It delivers top performance on structured decision tasks, outperforming both LLMs and
title.zh: Introducing Microsoft-Decision-1, our new model for fast decision-making. It delivers top performance on structured decision tasks, outperforming both LLMs and

note.en: Nadella announced Microsoft-Decision-1, a new Microsoft model for fast structured decision-making that outperforms both LLMs and other decision models on latency and quality.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布推出Microsoft-Decision-1，这是微软新推出的快速决策模型，在结构化决策任务上的延迟和质量均优于通用大模型及其他决策模型。

title.en: Thank you, @POTUS, for this incredible honor today. I'm humbled to stand alongside so many giants of American innovation and looking forward for what we can con
title.zh: Thank you, @POTUS, for this incredible honor today. I'm humbled to stand alongside so many giants of American innovation and looking forward for what we can con

note.en: Nadella publicly thanked Trump for an honor received at a White House tech summit alongside other industry leaders.
note.zh: 纳德拉发推公开感谢特朗普在白宫科技峰会上授予的荣誉，与其他行业领袖同台受奖。

title.en: Today marks a new chapter for Windows, as we bring unmetered intelligence to every desk and every home, and make every PC a place where agents can work securely
title.zh: Today marks a new chapter for Windows, as we bring unmetered intelligence to every desk and every home, and make every PC a place where agents can work securely

note.en: Nadella announced that Windows is bringing "unmetered intelligence" to every PC, positioning Windows as a platform where AI agents can work securely on the user's behalf.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布 Windows 将为每台电脑带来"不限量的智能"，并将 Windows 定位为可让 AI 代理安全地代表用户工作的平台。

title.en: We’re supercharging Copilot on Windows with Hybrid Intelligence. With your permission, Copilot can tap into the context on your PC, take action for you, and use
title.zh: We’re supercharging Copilot on Windows with Hybrid Intelligence. With your permission, Copilot can tap into the context on your PC, take action for you, and use

note.en: Nadella announced Hybrid Intelligence for Copilot on Windows, letting it access on-PC context, take actions, and use local models when appropriate.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布Windows版Copilot将推出"混合智能"功能，可在用户授权下读取电脑上下文、代理执行操作，并在适当时使用本地模型。

title.en: Great to partner with NVIDIA as we kick off this next chapter for Windows. Thank you @JensenHuang and @sriramk for joining us today! https://t.co/Jh1os7T9Zu
title.zh: Great to partner with NVIDIA as we kick off this next chapter for Windows. Thank you @JensenHuang and @sriramk for joining us today! https://t.co/Jh1os7T9Zu

note.en: Announces a new Nvidia partnership for the next chapter of Windows, thanking Jensen Huang for joining the launch.
note.zh: 宣布与英伟达达成新合作以开启Windows下一章，并感谢黄仁勋出席发布活动。

title.en: We’re building Copilot as a new OS for work that spans every model, every form factor, and every task. Today, we’re announcing our biggest update to Copilot to
title.zh: We’re building Copilot as a new OS for work that spans every model, every form factor, and every task. Today, we’re announcing our biggest update to Copilot to

note.en: Nadella announced Microsoft's biggest Copilot update yet, positioning it as an operating system for work spanning every model, device and task.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布微软对Copilot迄今为止最大规模的更新，将其定位为覆盖所有模型、设备和任务的“工作操作系统”。

title.en: The motivation behind the new Copilot: intelligence is accelerating fast. Now we need to diffuse it everywhere.
title.zh: The motivation behind the new Copilot: intelligence is accelerating fast. Now we need to diffuse it everywhere.

note.en: Nadella frames the new Copilot around diffusing fast-accelerating AI capability as broadly as possible, in a post that drew nearly 60,000 views.
note.zh: 纳德拉在一条浏览量近6万的推文中表示，新版Copilot的核心动机是让快速加速的AI能力尽可能广泛地普及。

title.en: Satya Nadella on Microsoft's agent bet and AI’s trust problem
title.zh: Satya Nadella on Microsoft's agent bet and AI’s trust problem

note.en: Nadella discusses Microsoft's bet on AI agents and the industry's trust problem in an interview with Alex Heath around the new Copilot unveiling.
note.zh: 纳德拉在接受Alex Heath采访时，围绕新版Copilot的发布，谈到了微软对AI智能体的押注以及行业面临的信任问题。

title.en: Great conversation with @chamath, @jason, @davidsacks, and @friedberg on all the work ahead when it comes to diffusing benefits of AI broadly, earning permissio
title.zh: Great conversation with @chamath, @jason, @davidsacks, and @friedberg on all the work ahead when it comes to diffusing benefits of AI broadly, earning permissio

note.en: Nadella discussed diffusing AI's benefits broadly, earning communities' trust, and AI safety in a conversation with the All-In podcast hosts.
note.zh: Nadella在与All-In播客主持人的对谈中，讨论了如何广泛普及AI红利、赢得社区信任以及AI安全问题。

title.en: Satya Nadella on the AI Doomer Slowdown, Microsoft's Master Plan & Who Wins AI
title.zh: Satya Nadella on the AI Doomer Slowdown, Microsoft's Master Plan & Who Wins AI

posts.source: All-In with Chamath, Jason, Sacks & Fr…

note.en: Nadella joined the All-In podcast to discuss the AI doomer slowdown debate and lay out Microsoft's AI strategy.
note.zh: 纳德拉做客All-In播客，谈论AI末日减速之争，并阐述了微软的AI战略规划。

title.en: Great example from @jeffhollan showing how Foundry makes long-running agents enterprise-ready, starting with business outcomes and building security, safety gua
title.zh: Great example from @jeffhollan showing how Foundry makes long-running agents enterprise-ready, starting with business outcomes and building security, safety gua

note.en: Nadella highlighted a Microsoft Foundry example of long-running enterprise agents built with security, safety guardrails, auditability and FinOps from the start.
note.zh: 纳德拉展示了微软Foundry的一个案例：从一开始就将安全防护、可审计性和FinOps融入企业级长时运行智能体。

title.en: Any pursuit of superintelligence has to be grounded in the core principle that if the AI we build is not helping humanity and under human control, it's not wort
title.zh: Any pursuit of superintelligence has to be grounded in the core principle that if the AI we build is not helping humanity and under human control, it's not wort

note.en: Nadella argued that any pursuit of superintelligence must stay grounded in human control and benefit to humanity, a stance that drew strong engagement (84k views).
note.zh: 纳德拉表示，对超级智能的追求必须始终以人类控制和人类福祉为前提，这一立场获得了很高的关注度（8.4万次浏览）。

title.en: Quincy, Washington shows what’s possible when you build datacenters with communities, and grow together over time.
title.zh: Quincy, Washington shows what’s possible when you build datacenters with communities, and grow together over time.

note.en: Nadella pointed to Microsoft's Quincy, Washington datacenter as a model for building AI infrastructure in partnership with local communities.
note.zh: 纳德拉以微软位于华盛顿州昆西的数据中心为例，阐述与当地社区合作共建AI基础设施的模式。

title.en: More model choice coming to Copilot. Welcome Grok!
title.zh: More model choice coming to Copilot. Welcome Grok!

note.en: Nadella announced that Grok is joining Copilot's model lineup, adding a rival lab's model to Microsoft's AI product.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布Grok加入Copilot的模型阵容，将一家竞争对手实验室的模型纳入微软的AI产品中。

title.en: This first-of-a-kind agreement will set a new standard for safe and responsible AI use in schools. We are making these protections available to every school dis
title.zh: This first-of-a-kind agreement will set a new standard for safe and responsible AI use in schools. We are making these protections available to every school dis

note.en: Nadella announced a new agreement setting AI safety standards for schools, with the protections extended to every school district in the US.
note.zh: Nadella宣布了一项为学校设立AI安全标准的新协议，相关保护措施将推广至美国所有学区。

title.en: It was a great week for innovation across the model ecosystem. We're bringing these new models into Copilot, enabling it to take on increasingly complex work, f
title.zh: It was a great week for innovation across the model ecosystem. We're bringing these new models into Copilot, enabling it to take on increasingly complex work, f

note.en: Nadella touts a strong week of model releases, saying Microsoft is bringing the new models into Copilot for increasingly complex, delegated work.
note.zh: Nadella称本周模型发布成果丰硕,微软正将新模型引入Copilot,使其能承担更复杂、可委托的任务。

title.en: Super excited about HydraFusion in GitHub Copilot, and what it shows about the shift from model selection to model orchestration. By bringing together multiple
title.zh: Super excited about HydraFusion in GitHub Copilot, and what it shows about the shift from model selection to model orchestration. By bringing together multiple

note.en: Highlighted HydraFusion in GitHub Copilot as a shift from model selection to model orchestration across multiple models working together.
note.zh: 强调GitHub Copilot中的HydraFusion标志着从单一模型选择转向多模型协同编排。

title.en: Excited to see early customers already using Astra on Azure! https://t.co/BeaR66ZL0G
title.zh: Excited to see early customers already using Astra on Azure! https://t.co/BeaR66ZL0G

note.en: Said early customers are already using OpenAI's Astra model on Azure.
note.zh: 表示已有早期客户在Azure上使用OpenAI的Astra模型。

title.en: Looking forward to this ecosystem with open models continuing to flourish and grow with NVIDIA and Hugging Face, and the continued partnership. Congrats @Jensen
title.zh: Looking forward to this ecosystem with open models continuing to flourish and grow with NVIDIA and Hugging Face, and the continued partnership. Congrats @Jensen

note.en: Congratulated Jensen Huang and Clement Delangue, saying he's looking forward to the open-model ecosystem continuing to flourish through Microsoft's partnerships with NVIDIA and Hugging Face.
note.zh: 他向黄仁勋和 Clement Delangue 表示祝贺，并称期待微软与英伟达、Hugging Face 的合作持续推动开源模型生态繁荣发展。

title.en: Delivery day at our Microsoft DCs as the first production Vera Rubins arrive. A huge thank you to our partners at @nvidia and our Azure hardware and datacenter
title.zh: Delivery day at our Microsoft DCs as the first production Vera Rubins arrive. A huge thank you to our partners at @nvidia and our Azure hardware and datacenter

note.en: Nadella marked the arrival of the first production NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems at Microsoft data centers, thanking NVIDIA and Azure hardware teams.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布首批量产NVIDIA Vera Rubin系统抵达微软数据中心,并感谢英伟达和Azure硬件团队。

title.en: Some more detail on the ROIC Intelligence App I built yesterday and mentioned on today's earnings call. I took the PDF that Brian Nowak at Morgan Stanley put to
title.zh: Some more detail on the ROIC Intelligence App I built yesterday and mentioned on today's earnings call. I took the PDF that Brian Nowak at Morgan Stanley put to

note.en: Nadella detailed the ROIC Intelligence App he built using a Morgan Stanley analyst's hyperscaler ROIC data, which he had mentioned on Microsoft's earnings call.
note.zh: 纳德拉详细介绍了他利用摩根士丹利分析师的超大规模云厂商ROIC数据构建的ROIC Intelligence应用,此前他曾在财报电话会议中提及此事。

title.en: Just wrapped our earnings call. It was a very strong close to what was a record fiscal year for Microsoft. · Annual revenue: $331B, +18% · MS Cloud: $214B, + 27
title.zh: Just wrapped our earnings call. It was a very strong close to what was a record fiscal year for Microsoft. · Annual revenue: $331B, +18% · MS Cloud: $214B, + 27

note.en: Nadella summarized Microsoft's FY2026 earnings call, citing $331B annual revenue (+18%), $214B Microsoft Cloud revenue (+27%) and $100B Azure revenue (+41%).
note.zh: 纳德拉总结了微软2026财年财报电话会议,称年收入达3310亿美元(+18%)、微软云收入2140亿美元(+27%)、Azure收入1000亿美元(+41%)。

title.en: A good read from Mark. Establishing a frontier ecosystem that empowers people and orgs everywhere is what we collectively need to build together.
title.zh: A good read from Mark. Establishing a frontier ecosystem that empowers people and orgs everywhere is what we collectively need to build together.

note.en: Nadella endorsed Mark Zuckerberg's essay, agreeing the industry needs to collectively build a frontier AI ecosystem that empowers people and organizations.
note.zh: 纳德拉认可马克·扎克伯格的文章,赞同业界需要共同构建一个赋能个人与组织的前沿AI生态系统。

title.en: Today, we are announcing a series of updates that give customers frontier-grade security at half the cost. MAI-Cyber-1-Flash is our first cybersecurity model, b
title.zh: Today, we are announcing a series of updates that give customers frontier-grade security at half the cost. MAI-Cyber-1-Flash is our first cybersecurity model, b

note.en: Nadella announced MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, Microsoft's first in-house cybersecurity model, alongside updates giving customers frontier-grade security at lower cost.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布推出微软首个自研网络安全模型MAI-Cyber-1-Flash,并公布了以更低成本提供顶尖安全能力的相关更新。

title.en: Open-weight models are essential to a healthy AI ecosystem. Together with others across our industry, we are outlining a path for open-weight models to strength
title.zh: Open-weight models are essential to a healthy AI ecosystem. Together with others across our industry, we are outlining a path for open-weight models to strength

note.en: Nadella argued open-weight models are essential to a healthy AI ecosystem and outlined a path for them to strengthen U.S. competitiveness.
note.zh: 纳德拉表示开放权重模型对健康的AI生态系统至关重要,并提出了借助开放权重模型增强美国竞争力的路径。

title.en: Really excited about our expanded partnership with @MistralAI, which is all about bringing customers more choice in how and where they deploy AI!
title.zh: Really excited about our expanded partnership with @MistralAI, which is all about bringing customers more choice in how and where they deploy AI!

note.en: Nadella announced an expanded partnership with Mistral AI aimed at giving customers more choice in how and where they deploy AI.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布与Mistral AI扩大合作,旨在为客户提供更多AI部署方式和位置上的选择。

title.en: An important piece from Demis. We need more of this kind of thinking. A good reminder that the goal is a frontier ecosystem that promotes innovation and choice,
title.zh: An important piece from Demis. We need more of this kind of thinking. A good reminder that the goal is a frontier ecosystem that promotes innovation and choice,

note.en: Nadella endorsed a piece by Demis Hassabis, agreeing the goal should be a frontier AI ecosystem that promotes innovation and choice rather than one model dominating.
note.zh: 纳德拉认可戴米斯·哈萨比斯的文章,赞同目标应是促进创新与选择的前沿AI生态,而非由单一模型主导。

title.en: Love this end-to-end example from @jeffhollan of what is now possible when you build long-running agents with Foundry. All now GA.
title.zh: Love this end-to-end example from @jeffhollan of what is now possible when you build long-running agents with Foundry. All now GA.

note.en: Nadella praised a demo by Microsoft's Jeff Hollan showing long-running agents built with Foundry, now generally available.
note.zh: 纳德拉称赞微软员工Jeff Hollan展示的基于Foundry构建的长时运行智能体演示,该功能现已全面上线。

title.en: Super to see GPT-5.6 with Work IQ come to Copilot Chat, Cowork, M365 apps, GitHub, and Foundry today. From multi-step agentic work to analysis and content creat
title.zh: Super to see GPT-5.6 with Work IQ come to Copilot Chat, Cowork, M365 apps, GitHub, and Foundry today. From multi-step agentic work to analysis and content creat

note.en: Nadella announced GPT-5.6 with Work IQ rolling out across Copilot Chat, Cowork, M365 apps, GitHub and Foundry.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布搭载Work IQ的GPT-5.6已在Copilot Chat、Cowork、M365应用、GitHub和Foundry上线。

title.en: The future of the firm is a learning loop in which human capital and token capital compound. With our new Frontier Co., our ambition is to help every enterprise
title.zh: The future of the firm is a learning loop in which human capital and token capital compound. With our new Frontier Co., our ambition is to help every enterprise

note.en: Nadella described Microsoft's new 'Frontier Co.' initiative to help every enterprise build its own AI capability as human and 'token' capital compound.
note.zh: 纳德拉介绍了微软新推出的"Frontier Co."计划,旨在帮助每家企业在人力资本与"token资本"叠加增长中建立自身AI能力。

title.en: Today we’re bringing skills to Copilot for Excel, giving teams a new way to scale their expertise across every workbook. https://t.co/DfD1nfPEO3
title.zh: Today we’re bringing skills to Copilot for Excel, giving teams a new way to scale their expertise across every workbook. https://t.co/DfD1nfPEO3

note.en: Nadella announced Copilot skills coming to Excel, letting teams scale expertise across workbooks.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布Copilot技能功能登陆Excel,帮助团队在各个工作簿中扩展专业能力。

title.en: New Azure milestone. The fastest time to train yet at the largest reported scale for this leading AI training benchmark. A great example of what is possible whe
title.zh: New Azure milestone. The fastest time to train yet at the largest reported scale for this leading AI training benchmark. A great example of what is possible whe

note.en: Nadella announced a new Azure milestone: the fastest training time yet at the largest reported scale on a leading AI training benchmark.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布Azure新里程碑:在一项主流AI训练基准测试中,以目前报告过的最大规模实现最快训练时间。

title.en: Copilot Cowork is now generally available worldwide, now with multi-model support! Every organization can put long-running agents to work on complex, multi-step
title.zh: Copilot Cowork is now generally available worldwide, now with multi-model support! Every organization can put long-running agents to work on complex, multi-step

note.en: Nadella announced Copilot Cowork's general availability worldwide with new multi-model support for long-running agent tasks.
note.zh: 纳德拉宣布Copilot Cowork在全球正式上线,新增多模型支持,可处理长时间运行的智能体任务。

title.en: Today in @naturemethods, we shared research on how AI can help us better understand cell behavior, offering new insights into why cancer medicines do not work t
title.zh: Today in @naturemethods, we shared research on how AI can help us better understand cell behavior, offering new insights into why cancer medicines do not work t

note.en: Nadella shared Microsoft research published in Nature Methods on using AI to better understand why cancer drugs work differently across patients.
note.zh: 纳德拉分享了微软发表于《自然·方法》的研究成果,利用AI探究癌症药物在不同患者身上疗效差异的原因。

title.en: Great to see NHS England scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot to more than 500,000 staff. In early trials, staff saved an average of 43 minutes per day, helping put mo
title.zh: Great to see NHS England scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot to more than 500,000 staff. In early trials, staff saved an average of 43 minutes per day, helping put mo

note.en: Nadella highlighted NHS England scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot to more than 500,000 staff, with early trials showing 43 minutes saved per person per day.
note.zh: 纳德拉介绍英国国家医疗服务体系(NHS)将Microsoft 365 Copilot推广至超过50万名员工,早期试点显示人均每天节省43分钟。

title.en: Satya Nadella on making human and token capital compound
title.zh: Satya Nadella on making human and token capital compound

note.en: Long-form interview with Reid Hoffman on Possible, recorded just after Microsoft Build 2026, in which Nadella argues that human capital and token capital have to compound together.
note.zh: 在 Reid Hoffman 的 Possible 播客中的长访谈，录制于 2026 年 Microsoft Build 之后，他在其中论述人力资本与算力（token）资本必须共同复利增长。

body.zh: 纳德拉公开支持放慢AI开发速度，呼应阿莫代伊的呼吁，加入本周行业安全大辩论。

title.en: Satya Nadella Says AI Must Help Humanity and Remain Under Human Control
title.zh: Satya Nadella Says AI Must Help Humanity and Remain Under Human Control

body.en: Satya Nadella stated that AI must help humanity while remaining under human control.
body.zh: Satya Nadella表示，AI必须造福人类，并始终保持在人类可控范围内。

title.en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Backs Artificial Intelligence Slowdown as Beijing Rejects Calls to Curb Chinese AI
title.zh: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Backs Artificial Intelligence Slowdown as Beijing Rejects Calls to Curb Chinese AI

body.en: Nadella publicly backed a slowdown in AI development even as Beijing rejected calls to curb Chinese AI, a notable stance from a major-lab-adjacent CEO on the pace of the race.
body.zh: 纳德拉公开支持放缓AI发展步伐，而与此同时北京拒绝了遏制中国AI的呼吁——作为身处AI竞赛核心的CEO，这一立场颇为引人注目。

title.en: ‘AI not worth pursuing if...’: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella warns against AI slipping beyond human control
title.zh: ‘AI not worth pursuing if...’: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella warns against AI slipping beyond human control

body.en: Satya Nadella warned that AI is not worth pursuing if it slips beyond human control, joining the industry-wide debate over slowing AI development.
body.zh: Satya Nadella警告称，如果AI失去人类控制，那么追求它将不再有意义，加入了业界关于放缓AI发展的争论。

title.en: Nadella Calls for Deliberate AI Safety Testing
title.zh: Nadella Calls for Deliberate AI Safety Testing

body.en: In an internal memo, Nadella told Microsoft employees to keep AI development under human control, pace alignment work deliberately, and expand third-party safety testing.
body.zh: 萨蒂亚·纳德拉在一份内部备忘录中，要求微软员工保持对AI开发的人为掌控，审慎推进对齐工作，并扩大第三方安全测试。

title.en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella’s big AI warning: ‘It’s not worth pursuing’ without human control
title.zh: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella’s big AI warning: ‘It’s not worth pursuing’ without human control

body.en: Satya Nadella warned that pursuing AI 'is not worth it' without maintaining human control, a public stance on AI safety guardrails.
body.zh: 萨提亚·纳德拉警告称，若不能保持人类对AI的控制，追求AI发展"并不值得"，这是他在AI安全护栏问题上的公开表态。

title.en: ‘If it’s not under human control, it’s not worth pursuing’: Satya Nadella's warning on AI
title.zh: ‘If it’s not under human control, it’s not worth pursuing’: Satya Nadella's warning on AI

body.en: Nadella warned that AI development is only worth pursuing if it remains under human control.
body.zh: 纳德拉警告称，只有在人类可控的前提下，AI的发展才值得推进。

title.en: 'Not Worth Pursuing If...': Satya Nadella Joins AI Slowdown Debate
title.zh: 'Not Worth Pursuing If...': Satya Nadella Joins AI Slowdown Debate

body.en: Nadella publicly weighed in on the AI slowdown debate, saying some AI spending may not be worth pursuing.
body.zh: 纳德拉公开加入AI放缓争论，表示部分AI投入可能并不值得推进。

title.en: ‘AI must remain under human control’: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella backs slower development
title.zh: ‘AI must remain under human control’: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella backs slower development

body.en: Nadella said AI must remain under human control and backed a slower pace of development, a notable public stance on AI safety.
body.zh: 纳德拉表示AI必须保持在人类控制之下，并支持放缓开发节奏，这是他在AI安全问题上的重要公开表态。

title.en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella backs need for evaluators for AI systems amid 'slowdown' debate
title.zh: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella backs need for evaluators for AI systems amid 'slowdown' debate

body.en: Nadella publicly backed the need for independent evaluators of AI systems amid the ongoing debate over whether AI development should slow down.
body.zh: 在关于AI发展是否应放缓的争论中，纳德拉公开支持为AI系统建立独立评估机制的必要性。

title.en: Satya Nadella announces Grok rollout to Copilot, expanding Microsoft’s AI offering
title.zh: Satya Nadella announces Grok rollout to Copilot, expanding Microsoft’s AI offering

body.en: Nadella announces the rollout of xAI's Grok model within Microsoft Copilot, expanding Microsoft's multi-model AI strategy to include a rival lab's frontier model.
body.zh: 纳德拉宣布将xAI的Grok模型接入Microsoft Copilot，将竞争对手实验室的前沿模型纳入微软的多模型AI战略。

title.en: Microsoft’s Satya Nadella Unveils New AI Push for Copilot
title.zh: Microsoft’s Satya Nadella Unveils New AI Push for Copilot

body.en: Nadella unveiled a new AI push for Microsoft Copilot.
body.zh: 纳德拉公布了针对微软Copilot的新一轮AI功能推进计划。

title.en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella announces new AI models for Copilot, powered by Opal frontier
title.zh: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella announces new AI models for Copilot, powered by Opal frontier

body.en: Nadella announced new AI models being added to Copilot, powered by what the coverage calls the 'Opal frontier.'
body.zh: Nadella宣布为Copilot引入新的AI模型,报道称由所谓的“Opal frontier”提供支持。

title.en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Says 'Every Model Is Substitutable' — What That Means For OpenAI
title.zh: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Says 'Every Model Is Substitutable' — What That Means For OpenAI

body.en: Nadella publicly states that every model is substitutable, signalling Microsoft's intent to reduce dependence on any single supplier including OpenAI.
body.zh: 纳德拉公开表示“任何模型都是可替代的”，释放出微软要降低对包括 OpenAI 在内的单一供应商依赖的信号。

title.en: Microsoft posts record revenue, CEO Satya Nadella says AI super app is next
title.zh: Microsoft posts record revenue, CEO Satya Nadella says AI super app is next

body.en: Microsoft posted record revenue, and Nadella said an 'AI super app' is the company's next move.
body.zh: 微软公布创纪录营收，纳德拉表示公司下一步将推出“AI超级应用”。

title.en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Warns of Enterprise AI Data Risks
title.zh: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Warns of Enterprise AI Data Risks

body.en: Nadella publicly warned enterprises about AI data risks, a notable cautionary stance from Microsoft's CEO on enterprise AI adoption.
body.zh: 纳德拉公开警示企业AI数据风险，这是微软CEO在企业AI应用问题上发出的一个值得关注的警示性表态。

title.en: Microsoft’s Satya Nadella says companies are ‘paying for their own IP,’ offers fix
title.zh: Microsoft’s Satya Nadella says companies are ‘paying for their own IP,’ offers fix

body.en: Nadella argues companies adopting AI are effectively 'paying for their own IP' and proposes a fix to that dynamic.
body.zh: Nadella认为企业采用AI实际上是在“为自己的知识产权买单”,并就此提出解决方案。

title.en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Says Businesses 'Pay for Intelligence Twice,' Warns AI Can Cost Companies Pro
title.zh: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Says Businesses 'Pay for Intelligence Twice,' Warns AI Can Cost Companies Pro

body.en: Satya Nadella warned that businesses effectively 'pay for intelligence twice,' cautioning that poorly deployed AI can hurt company profitability.
body.zh: Satya Nadella警告企业实际上是在"为智能支付两次"，提醒部署不当的AI可能损害公司盈利能力。

title.en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella warns AI dominance could 'hollow out entire industries'
title.zh: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella warns AI dominance could 'hollow out entire industries'

body.en: Nadella warned that AI dominance could "hollow out entire industries," a notable public caution about AI's economic disruption.
body.zh: 纳德拉警告称，AI领域的主导地位可能"掏空整个行业"，这是他就AI经济颠覆性影响发出的重要公开警示。
